interest: Index on suspected espionage ties of Japanese consul Esteban Prieto.
overview: This file consists of a single Department of State 'List of Papers' docket sheet (Form DS-25-46) dated October 12, 1945, indexing records under decimal classification 894.20238 concerning Japanese military activities, espionage, and propaganda in Haiti between 1940 and 1942. The docket entries summarize diplomatic reporting from Port-au-Prince and Ciudad Trujillo, covering security concerns regarding Bata Shoe Company branch manager Frantisek Vetava, alleged Japanese political interference schemes involving former consul Esteban Prieto and Haitian intermediary Gérard Lescot, commercial shipments to Japan connected to Walter Geiger, and intelligence assessments of Japanese propaganda. Because all substantive despatches and telegrams were transferred or cross-referenced to other decimal files (notably 894.20210 for Esteban Prieto and 811.111 for Bata Shoe Company), this index sheet constitutes the entire physical file.

subfiles.about: A State Department docket sheet indexing correspondence and intelligence reports on Japanese espionage, propaganda, and commercial activities in Haiti from 1940 to 1942.
subfiles.summary: This list of papers summarizes five items indexed under decimal file 894.20238 regarding Japanese activities and intelligence in Haiti between 1940 and 1942. The entries record security concerns surrounding Bata Shoe Company manager Frantisek Vetava, reports on suspected Japanese political interference involving former consul Esteban Prieto and Gérard Lescot, inquiries into shipments to Japan and the activities of Walter Geiger, and a confirmation that no Japanese propaganda or commercial agents were active in Haiti by 1942. The sheet indicates that the substantive documents were either transferred to related files, such as 894.20210 (Esteban Prieto), or cross-referenced under files including 811.111 and 894.20239.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Military Activities of Japan in Haiti
